repairs.before: Choose urn U with prior probability 2/7, otherwise urn V. U has 12 red and 9 blue balls; V has 5 red and 10 blue balls. Draw 6 balls uniformly without replacement from the chosen urn and observe exactly 2 red and 4 blue, with order unobserved. What is the posterior probability that U was chosen? Give an exact fraction.
